entities.title: Recognition Measure for a Foreign Qualification
entities.summary: This page provides information on the recognition of foreign professional qualifications in Germany, specifically for applications at the German Consulate-General Karachi.
eligibility: Assessment note by a competent authority in Germany
German language proficiency level A2 CEFR
required_documents: Assessment note (Defizitbescheid, Zwischenbescheid) by a competent authority in Germany
Proof of German language proficiency level A2 CEFR
application_process: Prepare visa application as explained in the provided checklist
Submit application through the Consular Services Portal (for German Embassy Islamabad)
important_notes: Applications at the German Embassy Islamabad are handled via the Consular Services Portal
Please familiarize yourself with the visa category and its requirements before applying
mandatory_prerequisites: Assessment note by a competent authority in Germany
